metadata.title: Design and Clone a gRNA for a CRISPR Experiment
metadata.purpose: Plan a CRISPR experiment and gRNA cloning workflow using the ordered design sections in Addgene's linked guide.
metadata.scope: This source is a design guide, not a protocol for one specified gRNA vector. The selected vector's protocol is required before executable cloning steps can be encoded.

tables.title: Addgene manipulation-to-targeting guidance
rows: Target constitutively expressed regions, 5′ exons, or an essential protein domain.
Select a cut site as close as possible to the intended edit; ideally less than 10 bp away.

steps.action: Define the desired genetic manipulation and select a compatible Cas system using table t1.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Source section: Select Your Desired Genetic Manipulation.

steps.action: Select the genomic element to target according to the intended manipulation.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Source section: Select Genetic Element to be Targeted.

steps.action: Use gRNA design software to generate candidate gRNAs for the selected target.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Source section: Design and Clone Your gRNA.

steps.action: Assess predicted on-target activity and off-target activity, then verify the target locus sequence in the actual sample.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Source section: Select gRNAs Based On Predicted On-Target and Off-Target Activity.

steps.action: Select a gRNA expression vector and obtain its associated protocol before designing the physical cloning workflow.
steps.criticalNotes: The linked guide directs users to the protocol associated with the selected plasmid; the source does not identify a vector.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Source section: Synthesize and Clone Desired gRNAs.

steps.action: Where the selected vector protocol supports it, synthesize, anneal, and insert the targeting oligos by restriction-ligation cloning using that vector-specific procedure.
steps.criticalNotes: No selected vector, enzyme, volume, temperature, or duration is supplied by the linked guide.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Source section: Synthesize and Clone Desired gRNAs.

steps.action: Select the Cas/gRNA expression and delivery system for the target cells, deliver the components, and validate the intended edit.

sourceReferences.excerpt: Source section: Select Your Expression and Delivery System.

limitations: The official linked guide does not specify a gRNA vector. Without it, a vector-specific cloning recipe cannot be retrieved or safely inferred.
